items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: And the first lesson I had with him I had just been written up in Down Beat, Dizzy’s pianist and all this.

ctx.x: Wow. I haven’t heard his name for a while.

And the first lesson I had with him I had just been written up in Down Beat, Dizzy’s pianist and all this. And I went and I took a lesson with Hall and I said, “I don’t know anything.” I walked out of there feeling all dejected. I said here I am in DownBeat magazine and I don’t know anything man. So I told myself like what you should do is just tell yourself you’re a dummy and then pick up, soak up like a sponge everything this man can teach you. Six months later I was in a different place man. And the stuff I…
I see. Wow. That was very interesting. It seems for many years the thing, and it probably still is, okay you’ve got to go to New York.
